guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: Errors surface at frontend (3123 'request error' logs, error rate up about 1000x) and in checkoutservice spans on every worst trace, and the only other service logging errors is paymentservice (3 lines), a callee of checkoutservice. Workloads and latencies dropped everywhere, which fits requests failing early at checkout; the digest has no paymentservice metrics and no trace reaching it, so the fault type is a guess.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect paymentservice logs and network connectivity from checkoutservice to paymentservice. If packet loss or connection failures are confirmed, restore the network path or restart the paymentservice pod. No destructive action until confirmed.
